# Maintained Gungnir port

Promoes owns this local port of [Gungnir v2.0.0-alpha.26](https://github.com/Renovamen/vuepress-theme-gungnir/tree/1e8f40061cf66d58879f26aead7308946d6c8b85), adapted for VuePress 2.0.0-rc.31. The upstream release targets beta.49; it cannot be installed alongside the current core without retaining an obsolete runtime. These sources replace the published theme dependency and keep its components, layouts, social links, search overlay, code controls and Sass styling. This port is maintained by this repository's maintainers, independently of upstream Gungnir.

`gungnir/LICENSE` retains the Apache-2.0 license and copyright. Each copied plugin directory retains its upstream MIT license. Modified source files carry notices. The local `plugins/container.ts` adapter is repository code under MIT. These licenses are separate from article photograph licenses.

The port registers layouts through client configuration, obtains page data during setup, copies extracted headings into public page data, captures Vue's injection context during computed navigation, awaits generated pages, and keeps case-sensitive tag URLs and empty template tag routes. Current RC ecosystem packages provide blog metadata, highlighting, PWA, analytics, image zoom, math and Mermaid rendering. Search, reading time, Markdown extensions, code controls and JSON charts retain small local adapters without beta dependencies. Chart rendering uses `JSON.parse` and destroys its instance on unmount; executable callback deserialization has been removed.

The build template uses the current SSR placeholders while keeping the exact existing color-mode script and CSP hash. The site imports its custom stylesheet explicitly. Sass's existing import and color-function deprecations remain compatible with the pinned Sass version. The configured site disables Giscus, RSS and Baidu analytics; their obsolete node adapters are not included in this port.

For upgrades, inspect the source diff and registry metadata, align core/client/bundler, review every override, and repeat clean install, security tests, audit, build, HMR and browser verification. The acceptance scope includes all existing post URLs, About/Team links, home/tag/search navigation, responsive layouts, both theme modes, math/diagram/chart fixtures, PWA output and enforced CSP. `DOCS_VERIFY_FEATURES=1 yarn docs:build` adds a local-only `/verification/features/` page from `scripts/fixtures-features.md`; rebuild without that variable before deploying.
